name: climier
description: JSON-first task DAG CLI for coordinating work, decisions, and claims

scripts.build:ui: bun install --cwd ui --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ui build
scripts.smoke:pack: bun install --cwd ui --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ui build && bun scripts/smoke-packed.ts
scripts.lint:cut: oxlint bin scripts src/cli/commands/ui.ts src/cli/dispatch.ts test/package.test.ts test/retired-surfaces.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build:ui && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const tag=process.env.RELEASE_TAG?.replace(/^v/,'');const version=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version;if(!tag||tag!==version){console.error('RELEASE_TAG must match package.json version');process.exit(1)}" && bun run test && bun run surface:check && bun run lint:cut && bun run pack:check
